counts.source_loss_note: Axial escape is a subset of escaped charge; do not add both. Endpoint IDs give exact macro counts; charge deltas give represented physical counts, not per-sink macro counts.

quantile_definition: Weighted inverse empirical CDF by unchanged seed particle weights; unweighted nearest-rank quantiles. Survivor motion is conditional on IDs present at both endpoints.
limitations: Endpoint displacement is a chord, not path length, gyro radius, orbit, or trajectory.
Particles born and lost between endpoints have no saved positions here.
No force-loop E/B samples are stored in these checkpoints; endpoint speeds or spatial density do not identify a cause of motion.
The plotted density is an aggregate projection/slab population; persistent density shape does not imply stationary individual particles.
Tracking selection is retrospective and survivor-conditioned, intended for trajectory inspection rather than an unbiased population estimate.
